external_authority.GRS_exact_scope: Theorem I.1 identifies scalar full and half boundary pressures; Theorem VI.7 gives the Half-Periodic normalized trace formula; Theorem VII.10 supplies scalar subdominant-coupling bounds; Theorem VIII.2 identifies all sixteen covariance-boundary/Wick-reference pressures on independently growing rectangles. external_authority.boundary: The sources do not state the coupled eight-component Q3 theorem. This package writes the finite-index proof port using Q3 radial coercivity and product hypercontractivity. It is not a literal tensor product of interacting scalar theories and makes no world-first claim.

finite_component_GRS_port.Gaussian_conditioning: C1<=C2 lifts to C1 tensor I8<=C2 tensor I8, and the multivariate Wick heat identity gives E_eta[:P(Phi+eta):_(C1+Ceta)|Phi]=:P(Phi):_C1; conditional Jensen reproduces the GRS partition inequalities.
finite_component_GRS_port.Wick_heat: :P:_c=exp[-c Delta_8/2]P, Delta_8 W4=3 q^T A_Q3 q and Delta_8^2 W4=48(g+4lambda).
finite_component_GRS_port.subdominant_coupling_theorem: For symmetric matrix B and scalar b on R subset A, normalized log partitions are uniformly bounded on fixed balls of ((|A|^-1 int ||B||_HS^2)^1/2+|A|^-1 int |b|), uniformly in ultraviolet cutoff, rectangles and X=F,D,N,P.
finite_component_GRS_port.coercive_absorption: For degree r<4, |a q^gamma|<=epsilon|q|^4+C_r epsilon^(-r/(4-r))|a|^(4/(4-r)); in particular |q^T Bq|/2<=theta W4+||B||_op^2/(16 theta c4).
finite_component_GRS_port.uniformity_proof: Undoing Wick gives finitely many component-labelled chaoses; product OU hypercontractivity and scalar spatial kernel estimates port GRS VII.11-VII.13; conditioning, FKN localization, unit-block linear-volume recovery and the Duhamel series are dimension-blind, while finite multi-index multiplicity changes only constants.
finite_component_GRS_port.not_factorization: Only the Gaussian and analytic estimates tensor over eight labels. The coupled Q3 interaction and partition function do not factor into scalar theories.

boundary_identification.Wick_difference: For delta_XY=C_A^X(x,x)-C_A^Y(x,x), the exact identity is :P_K:_Y=:P_(K+3 delta_XY A_Q3):_X+(delta_XY/2)TrK_pl+6 delta_XY^2(g+4lambda). Exchanging X,Y reverses only the terms linear in delta_XY, not the squared term.
boundary_identification.image_decay: GRS massive image estimates give |A|^-1 int(|delta_XY|+delta_XY^2)->0 as the shorter rectangle side tends to infinity.
boundary_identification.convex_Lipschitz: Uniform boundedness on the subdominant-coupling ball plus convexity gives |p_A^(X,Y)-p_A^(X,X)|->0.
boundary_identification.all_sixteen: The diagonal Dirichlet/Neumann brackets and not-feeling-the-boundary proof, with the finite-component estimates above, give lim p_A^(X;Y)=alpha_infinity for all sixteen covariance-boundary/Wick-reference choices when both sides grow independently. The four diagonal choices are full pressures. The four Y=F choices are the Half-X family and overlap the diagonal family at (F;F); equivalently, the twelve off-diagonal choices split into three nontrivial Half-X objects and nine other generalized mismatches.

periodic_ground_and_KL.half_periodic_transfer: For the Section-VIII Half-P object p_A^HP=p_A^(P;F), meaning periodic Gaussian covariance with plane/free Wick ordering and not the Section-VI coordinate-mixed full pressure p^(P|F), GRS Theorem VI.7 gives exp(st p_(s,t)^HP)=Tr exp(-t H_s^(per,u))/Tr exp(-t H_(0,s)). At fixed s this gives lim_(t->infinity)p_(s,t)^HP=-E_s^(per,u)/s; choosing t_n>=n with error below 1/n proves lim_(s->infinity)-E_s^(per,u)/s=alpha_infinity without a projection rate uniform in s.
periodic_ground_and_KL.rectangle_KL_ledger: d(beta,L)=p_(beta,L)^(P,F)(u)+c_(beta,L), where c_(beta,L)=(D_pl/2)TrK_pl+6D_pl^2(g+4lambda)->0 when both sides grow independently.
periodic_ground_and_KL.scalar_limits: The joint rectangular and both iterated specific-KL density limits exist and equal alpha_infinity; exact beta-L exchange supplies the second iterated limit.
periodic_ground_and_KL.state_boundary: Only scalar pressure, energy and KL densities are identified. Measures, states, vectors, gaps and correlators are not interchanged.

This package explicitly ports their proof to the radially coercive coupled eight-component Q3 interaction; it does not claim that the vector theorem appears verbatim in the source or that the full TECT Pre-A chain has prior or local closure.
